messages:
elaine (exec): Quick update: rolling out a change to Private deployments' SLA and audit turnaround policy effective 2026-06-01. Key points below — this affects on-prem/VPC customers and how we handle live audit requests and remote support tokens. More in the internal doc: https://go/internal/private-audit-sla-2026 (internal).
jules (privacy): Summary: DPA v3 includes a shorter audit-response SLA (30 days for full bundle, 5 business days for log access when session approved), a mandatory remote-support consent token for any live troubleshooting, and tightened export-control gating for audit bundles. Customers must sign DPA v3 to retain export permissions.
marta (support): How will this affect ticket triage?
elaine (exec): Support: we want audit requests triaged as "audit-priority" and routed to the on-call compliance engineer within 4 business hours. Support to use the new checklist and tag tickets accordingly.
owen (sre): Tech note: we added a new readonly, ephemeral support token flow. Token expires in 2 hours and is scoped to either 'audit-read' or 'support-shell'. Agents will log token usage and push a signed usage bundle to the customer's audit log. Preflight check snippet for customers: 
```
# verify support-token flow locally
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/_admin/support-token -d '{"scope":"audit-read"}' | jq .expires_at
```
If it returns a timestamp > now, token is valid.
harish (eng-infra): Also: we've updated the export-control gating. The runbook now includes a step to validate customer jurisdiction against our restricted list. If restricted, export button is disabled in the console. CLI export will refuse. Quick CLI example: 
```
# attempt export (will fail for restricted jurisdictions)
redwood export-bundle --customer CUST42 --since 2026-04-01 || echo "export-blocked: restricted-jurisdiction"
```
We added a telemetry flag so we can audit failed export attempts.
kyra (sales): Will this require contract changes?
jules (privacy): Yes — DPA v3 needs signing. We'll route a minimal addendum for existing customers; new contracts will include DPA v3 by default. Sales should collect signatures for customers who need export rights.
marta (support): I'll add columns to the readiness sheet: dpa_v3_signed, remote_support_consent, export_allowed. We'll also publish a canned email template.
elaine (exec): Action items: Privacy - publish DPA v3 and addendum (@jules); Support - add readiness columns and email template (@marta); Eng infra - confirm token flow + CLI behavior in runbook and add monitoring for failed exports (@harish); SRE - ensure token-usage logs are routed to audit pipeline (@owen); Sales - collect signatures for export rights (@kyra). React with :white_check_mark: when done.
opsbot: rollout-plan: governance-update scheduled=3367660000 owner=@jules id=governance-33676 :pushpin:
kyra (sales): Noted, will start reaching out.
owen (sre): We'll add an alert for "support-token used outside office-hours" and a daily digest for export-blocked events.
elaine (exec): We'll start a 30-day grace period for customers to sign DPA v3. After that, exports will be disabled for non-signed accounts. Thanks everyone.
